intro: Whiteout is painting, she looks up and there is a view out the window of siloutes of dragons staring and whispering, barely visible (at 'castle walls')

part two: She walks out of her room, and sees foeslayer and arctic fighting. she steps back, curls up on the flour and covers her ears, shaking her head. 

part three: Darkstalker comes, helps her up, and puts his wing over her. She looks up at "don't you worry just..." 

part four: Whiteout follows darkstalker outside, he lifts his wing, introducing clearsight. (they take flight, switching to next scene following darkstalker's wing) 

part five: Whiteout meets Thoughtful, they're laughing and having fun. Darkstalker flies down and lands on "let me in,"

part six: Whiteout comes back home. Foeslayer, Arctic and  Darkstalker are getting ready for the party. cuts to zoomed-in on Foeslayer's earing at "knew she was hypnotized"

part seven: Switches to view of Fathom, Indigo, and other seawings. Switches again to back home. Arctic walks into her room. Shows Whiteout looking blankly, switches to view of 'whiteout's mind' - whiteout trying to get out of a black cage, around her is darkness at "Someone out there?" 

part eight: continues scene - whiteout trying to escape the cage. switches to Arctic and whiteout flying away. switches to whiteout looking panicked and trying to escape. switches to angery darkstalker, flying off to catch up with Arctic at "just let me in,"

part nine: Flashing fight between Arctic and Darkstalker, Whiteout behind, looking blankly at them. switches to bruised whiteout w/ tears, barging through the cage and quickly switching to darkstalker's talon above the scroll then to Whiteout suddenly back to herself at "let me in,"

part ten: Whiteout falls through the snow, then through black water, then emerges at  Arctic death scene. She breathes fast, running away. She sees Darkstalker "shadow" with a crown towering above her, smiling at "ooh, ooh..."

part eleven: Shadow Darkstalker raises a talon, showing a path with blood and a broken crown at the end of the path at "follow everywhere I go" 

part twelve: Darkstalker falls, a bracelet appearing around his wrist. Clearsight closed her eyes and turned. switches to clearsight flying away. Whiteout is left, bruised, bleeding, and closes her eyes. tears run down - extend after song ends to Thoughtful walking towards her and sits next to her. - fade out -

- End -
